description: Base Location: You'll be expected to spend 50% of your working week in our Dublin office Salary: €65,300 - €97,900 + performance-related bonus + a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family. description: Bentley Systems Location: Dublin, Ireland (Hybrid) Position Summary Bentley Systems is seeking a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own the strategy, execution, and performance of customer lifecycle marketing programs. The role is accountable for how customers are engaged from the point of purchase through onboarding, activation, adoption, retention, and expansion, and for translating that lifecycle into a coordinated program of cross-channel communications with measurable business impact. Working across Product Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Sales, Marketing Operations, and Analytics, you will define lifecycle journeys and audience segmentation, and build and maintain the programs that deliver them. The position calls for equal fluency in program strategy, marketing automation, and performance analysis. Responsibilities Lifecycle Strategy and Program Ownership Own the customer lifecycle marketing roadmap spanning onboarding, activation, adoption, engagement, retention, renewal, cross-sell, and win-back. Map customer journeys by persona, lifecycle stage, and product usage, identifying the moments where marketing intervention changes outcomes. Define the contact strategy and communication governance that determine cadence, channel priority, and message hierarchy across the customer base. Develop segmentation and personalization frameworks grounded in behavioral, firmographic, and product usage data. Translate business objectives for adoption, retention, and expansion into program-level goals, forecasts, and reporting commitments. Cross-Channel Program Execution Build and maintain automated customer journeys, nurture streams, and triggered campaigns in Marketo. Coordinate lifecycle messaging across email, in-product and in-app communications, web, and paid retargeting where appropriate. Partner with Product Marketing and Customer Success to define messaging, offers, and content requirements for each lifecycle stage. Perform end-to-end quality assurance on emails, landing pages, forms, data flows, and automation logic prior to launch. Maintain database health, subscription preferences, suppression logic, deliverability, and compliance with regional privacy requirements. Measurement and Optimization Define and report the metrics that govern lifecycle performance, including engagement, activation, product adoption, retention, churn risk, expansion, and customer lifetime value. Build and operate a testing roadmap covering audience, offer, creative, timing, and channel. Analyze cohort and program performance and convert findings into a prioritized set of program changes. Support lifecycle scoring and customer health models in partnership with Marketing Operations and Analytics. Establish scalable, documented processes and standards for lifecycle marketing across regions. Qualifications Five or more years of experience in lifecycle marketing, customer marketing, CRM marketing, or marketing automation, including ownership of programs from strategy through execution. Demonstrated experience designing and operating multi-stage customer journeys tied to retention or expansion goals. Hands-on proficiency with Marketo, including program build, smart campaign logic, and administration. Strong command of segmentation, personalization, and behavioral targeting. Analytical fluency, including performance reporting, cohort analysis, and test design. Excellent project management and cross-functional communication skills. Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or equivalent experience. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Salesforce CRM and connected marketing data models. Experience in B2B SaaS, subscription, or enterprise software environments. Experience with in-product or in-app messaging tools. Experience with ON24 or another enterprise webinar platform. Familiarity with customer health scoring, churn modeling, or lifecycle analytics. Experience operating global programs across multiple regions and languages. What We Offer A great Team and culture – please see our colleague video. An exciting career as an integral part of a world-leading software company providing solutions for architecture, engineering, and construction - watch this short documentary about how we got our start. An attractive salary and benefits package. A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups. A company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact. About Bentley Systems Around the world, infrastructure professionals rely on software from Bentley Systems to help them design, build, and operate better and more resilient infrastructure for transportation, water, energy, cities, and more. Founded in 1984 by engineers for engineers, Bentley is the partner of choice for engineering firms and owner-operators worldwide, with software that spans engineering disciplines, industry sectors, and all phases of the infrastructure lifecycle. Through our digital twin solutions, we help infrastructure professionals unlock the value of their data to transform project delivery and asset performance. www.bentley.com Equal Opportunity Employer Bentley is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and considers for employment all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, gender/gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, religion/belief, national origin, caste, age, or any other characteristic protected by local law or unrelated to job qualifications.

description: Synthflow AI is an enterprise AI agent platform that unifies customer operations across voice, chat, and messaging. Our agents handle routine interactions at scale so teams can focus on high-value work. Over 20M hours of operations automated 60% more calls answered vs. non-AI operators 150M interactions handled, 99.99% uptime Backed by Accel, Atlantic Labs, and Singular. Trusted by 1,000+ customers. Recognized as one of the most promising companies in Germany. About the role As Synthflow continues to scale, so does the complexity of how we build products. We’re looking for a Technical Product Manager to help create the operating system behind our Product organization. This is an execution-first role for someone who enjoys bringing structure to fast-moving environments. You’ll work across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Professional Services, and GTM to ensure our teams have the processes, insights, and operational foundations they need to ship quickly and reliably. You’ll own product operations, analytics, documentation and product discovery, freeing up senior product leadership to focus on long-term strategy while giving you the opportunity to grow into broader Product Management ownership over time. If you’re technically curious, highly organized, customer-focused, and excited by AI, this is a unique opportunity to help shape how one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies builds products. What you’ll do Partner with Engineering, Customer Success, GTM, and Professional Services to coordinate feature delivery, releases, and cross-functional initiatives. Build and maintain product analytics, dashboards, and reporting using tools like PostHog to measure adoption, quality, and business impact. Gather and synthesize customer feedback from calls, support, and internal teams to support product discovery and prioritization. Write clear product requirements, release notes, and internal documentation that enable teams to execute efficiently. Use AI tools and automation to improve product workflows, reduce manual work, and help the team move faster. What we’re looking for 2–5 years of experience in Product Operations, Technical Product Management, Product Management, Technical Program Management, Solutions Engineering, or a similar cross-functional role. Strong operational instincts; you enjoy bringing structure to ambiguity and keeping multiple stakeholders aligned and accountable. Technically comfortable, with experience working alongside engineers and familiarity with APIs, product analytics, and technical tooling. Bonus if you’ve worked with SQL or Python. Customer-oriented, with the ability to translate customer feedback into clear product requirements and actionable insights. Excellent written communication and documentation skills, with a high bar for organization and attention to detail. AI-native and excited to use tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and ChatGPT to improve how you and your team work. What you’ll work with Product: Linear, Notion, Productboard Analytics: PostHog, SQL, dashboards Engineering: APIs, GitHub, release workflows AI: Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT Collaboration: Slack, Google Workspace Founded in Berlin in 2023 by serial entrepreneurs Albert Astabatsyan, Hakob Astabatsyan, and Sassun Mirzakhan-Saky, Synthflow AI democratizes access to advanced voice AI with a no-code platform that lets enterprises easily create, deploy and scale natural-sounding, cost-effective voice agents tailored to their business needs.

description: Dit ga je doen Je werkt, samen met andere Product Owners en softwareontwikkelaars, aan het ontwerpen en doorontwikkelen van een intelligent softwareplatform voor de maakindustrie. Je speelt een sleutelrol in het vertalen van complexe klantprocessen naar logische, schaalbare functionaliteit. En dan met oog voor technische haalbaarheid én gebruikerspraktijk. Onze opdrachtgever gelooft dat digitalisering in de maakindustrie niet draait om standaardoplossingen, maar om wendbare platforms die naadloos meebewegen met klantconfiguraties, engineeringstructuren en productieprocessen. Jij zorgt dat die flexibiliteit technisch klopt én functioneel waarde toevoegt. Je werkt domeingericht aan thema’s als servitization, slimme stuklijsten (BOM), CPQ-integratie en AI-toepassingen binnen supply chain en orderverwerking. Daarbij leg je de functionele basis die developers nodig hebben om te bouwen: gestructureerde logica, slimme procesflows en heldere usecases. Kernwoorden zijn: configuratiegestuurd ontwikkelen, smart manufacturing, engineer-to-order, low-code integraties, iteratieve validatie en ketensamenhang. ### Dit krijg jij Je komt terecht in een organisatie waar technologie, inhoud en visie samenkomen. Geen logge processen of dikke procedures, maar korte lijnen, vakinhoudelijke diepgang en ruimte om zelf richting te geven aan jouw domein binnen het platform. - Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4.000,- en € 7.000,-, afhankelijk van ervaring en expertise Een auto van de zaak en goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling, opleidingen en certificering Mogelijkheid om door te groeien Werken aan software die niet alleen slim is, maar ook écht gebruikt wordt door engineers, planners en operators in de industrie Je krijgt geen keurslijf, maar verantwoordelijkheid. Geen standaardpakketten, maar slimme oplossingen die je zelf mede vormgeeft. ### Hier ga jij werken Onze opdrachtgever is een specialistisch softwarehuis dat zich volledig richt op de digitalisering van productiebedrijven. Vanuit het kantoor in Veenendaal werkt een compact team van zo’n 15 collega’s, onder wie ervaren software engineers en architecten met een achtergrond bij internationale partijen, dagelijks aan slimme, schaalbare oplossingen voor de maakindustrie. Wat hen drijft? Niet de hype van de technologie, maar de echte uitdagingen van productiebedrijven: complexiteit reduceren, afdelingen beter laten samenwerken en processen zo inrichten dat flexibiliteit en efficiency hand in hand gaan. Denk aan klantconfiguraties die doorwerken tot op de werkvloer, aan engineer-to-order omgevingen waarin snelheid en nauwkeurigheid cruciaal zijn, en aan software die zich aanpast aan het bedrijf. En niet andersom. De sfeer is nuchter, vakgedreven en ondernemend. Geen overbodige managementlagen, maar inhoudelijk sterke mensen die samen iets moois bouwen. Met een duidelijke visie op de toekomst, en een groeipad waar jij als Product Owner een belangrijke rol in speelt. ### Dit ben jij Eisen Je hebt een HBO- of WO-opleiding afgerond in een richting zoals Technische Bedrijfskunde, Informatica, Industriële Automatisering of een verwante technische studie. Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een rol als Product Owner, functioneel ontwerper of technisch analist in een softwaregedreven B2B-omgeving. Je bent analytisch sterk en denkt gestructureerd. Je weet hoe je complexe processen en klantwensen vertaalt naar logische softwarefunctionaliteit. Je begrijpt hoe techniek en bedrijfsprocessen elkaar beïnvloeden en je kunt die vertaalslag ook maken richting developers. Je werkt graag in multidisciplinaire teams, schakelt makkelijk tussen stakeholders en developers, en je bent vertrouwd met Agile/Scrum-methodiek. Wensen Ervaring met de maakindustrie (ETO/CTO), industriële software of Smart Manufacturing is een pré.

description: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process! About The Role International growth is next for Grüns, and this role is how we make it real. You'll own our paid media engine across the UK, EU, Canada, and ANZ, launching and scaling Meta and Google from the ground up in each market. This isn't a strategy seat. You'll build the campaigns, the tracking, and the playbooks yourself, then build the team around what works. Location: While this role is part of our global remote HQ, we feel a candidate based in or around Europe will be most successful in this role. The team members you'll be working with most are in multiple countries and time zones, so we ask that you are comfortable working a way that allows for some overlap in working hours to collaborate. More generally, we operate in a fully remote, high trust environment with teammates across multiple countries and time zones. While we work async by default, we come together in person twice a year for offsites that help us connect, align, and build real relationships IRL. In this role, you will: Launch and scale Meta and Google campaigns across our priority international markets, including the UK, Canada, ANZ, and key EU markets like Germany Own measurement end to end: CAPI, GA4, GDPR-compliant tracking, and a regular cadence of incrementality and lift testing Scale spend into the millions annually while protecting CAC, LTV/CAC, and contribution margin Build a repeatable testing engine across creative, audience, offer, and localized landing pages Partner closely with creative, product, and lifecycle teams to keep execution sharp across markets Build the foundation for a specialist team: hiring plan, workflows, vendor model, once performance is proven Own the quarterly international growth roadmap, including recommendations on new markets and channels We're looking for someone who: Has 5+ years in performance or growth marketing with hands-on paid media ownership, not just oversight Has personally launched and scaled Meta and Google campaigns in at least two international markets (Canada, Australia, UK, or a non-English-speaking EU market like Germany, the Netherlands, or France) Has scaled paid media spend into the millions annually while holding the line on CAC and contribution margin Has real command of GDPR-compliant tracking and measurement, including CAPI, GA4, and incrementality testing Comes from a high-growth DTC, subscription, or eCommerce business with real paid media dependence Has built campaigns in-house rather than at an agency. You've lived with the downstream impact of your own calls, not just made recommendations from the outside Approach to the role: Operates like an owner of the business, not a specialist waiting to be told what to test next Builds systems and playbooks that repeat, not one-off wins that don't scale Makes sharp decisions with imperfect data and gets more precise as the picture fills in Sees every market as its own puzzle, but never starts from scratch when a proven pattern already exists Compensation & Benefits: At Grüns, we are committed to offering a competitive total compensation package grounded in market data and aligned to our size, stage, industry, and geographic location. Compensation for this role will be benchmarked to the local market and may vary based on experience and country of hire. In addition to base compensation roles include a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. A bit about us... At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you. Like you, we were disappointed. There's an infinite number of "nutrition" companies, all focused on what's best for them — not what's best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We've seen it all. So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious. What we care about... Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation. Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners. Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most. Compensation & Perks: For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth. Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!
title: Paid Media Manager, International

description: Lovehoney Group is the world’s leading sexual wellbeing company, with the mission to elevate pleasure through innovative technologies, a data-driven approach, and foster creative and fresh perspectives on intimacy. We offer exciting brands with innovative, high-quality sex toys, lingerie, and accessories in a streamlined online shopping experience. At Lovehoney, we employ over 800 passionate and progressive individuals across 11 global offices, each person contributing a unique blend of talents to our diverse workforce. We are proud to be a company that thrives by doing things differently, challenging expectations and stereotypes while making a positive impact on our customers’ lives. Join us at Lovehoney, where pleasure combines with creativity, data, and innovation! We are currently looking for a Customer Value & Growth Manager, New Initiatives who will be integral to driving high-level performance across Lovehoney Group. Partnering closely with CRM, Trading, Brand, Supply Chain, Data, Legal, Compliance and regional teams, your focus will be on taking new customer value initiatives from idea to live, with an initial focus on SMS, parcel inserts and mainstream lead generation. In this role, you will combine your commercial judgement and analytical thinking with a hands-on approach to building, testing and scaling new initiatives. You will develop skills crucial to advancing in a competitive, fast-paced retail sector, all within a company that prizes dedication and results. What You Will Do Own the development and growth of SMS as a revenue-generating channel, including consented audience growth, programme design, CRM integration, cadence and compliance. Own parcel inserts and offline lead generation initiatives end-to-end, from proposition and supplier selection through to fulfilment, customer capture, consent and measurement. Support the mainstream marketing team in building customer acquisition and retention journeys, connecting offline lead capture with CRM, Email and SMS programmes. Take new channels and propositions from opportunity sizing and business case through to hands-on build, launch, measurement, scaling and handover, using experiments to identify what works and when to stop. Work AI-first to prototype, automate and analyse wherever possible, while unblocking cross-functional delivery and documenting processes so successful initiatives can become business as usual. What You Should Bring 3-5 years’ experience in growth, CRM, ecommerce, product, or a zero-to-one/new ventures environment, with a track record of personally delivering new initiatives. Strong project ownership and commercial judgement, with the ability to take an ambiguous opportunity from initial idea through to live delivery, build a business case and make clear decisions about whether to scale or stop. Hands-on experience with SMS or messaging, offline-to-digital customer acquisition, or similar customer growth initiatives, including an understanding of consent and compliance requirements, is highly desirable. Strong analytical and technical capability, including SQL or BigQuery, financial modelling, and the ability to use no-code/low-code tools, APIs, HTML/Liquid or light scripting to build prototypes. An AI-first, curious and proactive mindset, with practical experience using LLMs and automation to build, analyse and improve processes, combined with strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. What We Can Offer You A welcoming workplace full of drinks, snacks, friendly faces and fun team-building events. Access to unique discounts at high street retailers, hotels, and service providers, in addition to a 50% discount on all Lovehoney products to explore and discover new ways to have fun. Enjoy a hybrid work model that fosters flexibility and work-life balance, with three days per week in-office and the opportunity to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year, alongside 25 days’ holiday, plus an additional day for each year you are with Lovehoney, providing ample time for relaxation, rejuvenation, and exploration. Access to customized training opportunities to support your unique learning journey, complemented by biannual feedback cycles, offering valuable insights into your performance and growth areas, enhancing your development within the company. Recognising the significance of physical and mental health, we proudly provide gym benefits in addition to a mental wellbeing platform, to ensure our employees thrive both professionally and personally. Stay secure at work and at home with a complimentary 1Password Family account. All Lovehoney Group employees can invite up to five family members to join, offering your household a safe and simple way to manage passwords and sensitive information safely and easily. Our interview process CV review Interview with one of Talent Acquisition Team Members Hiring Manager Interview Hiring Team Interview Lovehoney Group is an equal opportunities employer. We promise that every qualified person will be evaluated according to skills regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation. If you require accommodations during the interview process due to a disability, please inform your Talent Acquisition Specialist so that we can ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. At Lovehoney Group, we embrace innovative technologies to enhance our recruitment process. We leverage artificial intelligence during screening interviews for CV reviews and note-taking. We prioritize transparency and respect your preferences, so you'll have the option to opt out of recording and AI-driven note-taking while still receiving full and fair consideration for the role. We currently have a hybrid work model supporting a blend of in-office and remote work (3 days per week in-office) If we sparked your interest and you are open to embarking on your professional path with us, please visit our Lovehoney careers page to apply: Careers | Lovehoney Group Our privacy policy is available here: Privacy Policy | Lovehoney Group We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. description: Über uns Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser . In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement. Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur. Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht. VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden ( 42b EnWG). Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance: Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer, ~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität. Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt. Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus. Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS. Dein Profil Du hast bereits professionelle Erfahrung im Bereich Energy Management Systeme (EMS/HEMS) und/oder mit IoT- und Datenplattformen Du hast ein gutes Verständnis von Smart Metering, CLS/ 14a EnWG, dynamische Stromtarife, Direktvermarktung oder Flexibilitätsvermarktung Du kannst technische Komplexität strukturieren und in klare Produktanforderungen, Roadmaps, Spezifikationen und Entscheidungsvorlagen übersetzen. Du bist stark in Research, Strukturierung und Entscheidungsfindung und kannst Make/Partner/Buy-Optionen fundiert aufbereiten. Du hast keine Berührungsängste mit regulatorischen Themen und kannst dich eigenständig in energiewirtschaftliche Fragestellungen einarbeiten. Du nutzt Daten und Metriken, um Hypothesen zu validieren, Prioritäten zu begründen und Produktentscheidungen messbar zu machen Du bringst ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Energiewelt und Start-ups oder Immobilien mit Du suchst bewusst keinen 9-to-5-Job, sondern willst in einem schnelllebigen, gründer-nahen Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen, Strukturen aufbauen und das Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten Du bist in Berlin (oder bereit umzuziehen) - unser Büro ist unser Homebase Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch fließend Deine Aufgaben Mission der Rolle Als Product Manager Energy bist du verantwortlich dafür, aufbauend auf unserer Smart-Meter- und CLS-Infrastruktur ein “first-of-its-kind” Energiemanagement- und Steuerungsprodukt zu entwickeln. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem COO sowie externen Partnern wie aEMT-, CLS-, GWA-, Hardware- und Software-Anbietern zusammen. Deine Aufgabe ist es, technische, regulatorische und kommerzielle Anforderungen zu verstehen und daraus eine klare Produkt-Roadmap, belastbare Spezifikationen und funktionierende Piloten abzuleiten. Produktentwicklung für Energy Intelligence (insb. EMS) Du übernimmst die produktseitige Verantwortung für unseren neuen Energy-Intelligence-Layer auf Basis von Smart Metern, CLS-Steuerboxen und steuerbaren Assets Du analysierst, welche Daten wir in welcher Granularität benötigen, z. B. Erzeugung, Verbrauch, Netzbezug, Einspeisung, Batteriestatus, Wärmepumpenlast, Wallbox-Verbrauch und Anlagenzustände Du entwickelst erste Steuerlogiken und Produktkonzepte für Use Cases wie Eigenverbrauchsoptimierung, 14a-Steuerbarkeit, dynamische Stromtarife, Direktvermarktung und perspektivisch Flexibilität/VPP Piloten, Partner und technische Konzeption Du hilfst uns, die Frage zu beantworten: Was bauen wir selbst, was machen wir mit Partnern, was kaufen oder integrieren wir? Du baust ein klares Verständnis dafür auf, welche Hardware-, Daten- und Steuerungsarchitektur wir für verschiedene Gebäudetypen und Asset-Kombinationen benötigen Du übersetzt energiewirtschaftliche und technische Anforderungen in konkrete Produktanforderungen, User Stories, Datenmodelle, Schnittstellenanforderungen und Akzeptanzkriterien Markt, Regulierung und strategische Produktentwicklung Du beobachtest relevante regulatorische Entwicklungen, insbesondere rund um CLS, 14a EnWG, Smart Metering, dynamische Tarife, Direktvermarktung, Energy Sharing und Flexibilität Du priorisierst Use Cases nach Kundennutzen, technischer Umsetzbarkeit, regulatorischer Relevanz und kommerziellem Potenzial Du managst gemeinsam mit Cedric (COO) und Martin (Head of Engineering) die Roadmap für unsere Energy-Produkte Benefits Verantwortung: zentrale Rolle in unserem Kernteam Vergütung: Kompetitives Gehalt und Anteile am Unternehmen Startdatum: so bald wie möglich, unbefristet Team & Benefits: Lustiges Team, Tech Budget von 2 Tsd.€, regelmäßige Team Events und Learning Lunches, Gratis Getränke, Deutschlandticket Weitere Vorteile: Tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, Getränke & Snacks, Personalverantwortung und die Möglichkeit, das Unternehmen von Grund auf mitzugestalten Das Wichtigste: Du brennst für Unternehmertum und Start-ups. Bei uns entstehen keine endlosen Slide-Decks oder rein theoretische Modelle – wir bauen ein Unternehmen und machen tagtäglich einen großen Schritt nach vorne. Wenn du von Tag 1 an etwas Großem mitgestalten möchtest, bist du bei uns genau richtig. Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss Bei VREY sind wir davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt uns als Unternehmen und Gesellschaft stärkt . Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, zögere nicht, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Wenn du von unserer Mission begeistert bist und glaubst, einen Beitrag leisten zu können, möchten wir von dir hören! Der beste Weg ist eine warme Intro: Kennst du jemand, der auf diese Rolle passt? Empfiehl die Person und erhalte 3.000€ bei erfolgreicher Einstellung. Voraussetzung: Die Person ist uns noch nicht bei uns im Prozess und wird offiziell vorgeschlagen. Auszahlung nach bestandener Probezeit. Bei mehrfacher Nennung zählt die erste eingegangene Empfehlung.

description: Exciting Opportunity: Product Owner IT Accounting & Control Do you thrive on developing and managing the IT landscape for our NIBC Finance Accounting & Control domain? Job Description: As our Product Owner (PO), you will play a key role in maximizing the value delivered by the Accounting & Control IT delivery team. You will collaborate closely with the Business Owner of Finance and the IT Manager Finance & Risk to translate business demands into strategic roadmaps, detailing initiatives and domain roadmaps as epics, which you will then guide into the team backlog as user stories. As the team's primary advocate, you will align business and technology strategies, enabling the team to balance multiple stakeholders needs while continuously evolving solutions and ensuring compliance with the wide range of IT regulations within the banking domain. Main Responsibilities Craft and maintain a product vision and roadmap for both run and change activities, drawing from market insights and IT trends. Manage and prioritize the Team Backlog based on value, and guide epics from the Domain Backlog into the Team Backlog. Ensure the team only works on items that are refined, acting as a safeguard and facilitator. Act as a sparring partner for the team, ensuring the solutions follow best practices for accounting systems and ETL processes. Collaborate with stakeholders, including the Business Owner, end users, Domain Architect, IT Manager, and Transformation Office, valuing all perspectives while setting priorities based on value. Support the delivery team in maximizing value delivery through tools and automated solutions, and clearly articulate the items on the team backlog. Grasp the critical success factors for Accounting & Control by understanding the context of financial closures and what matters most in this process. Actively contribute to the Product Owner Center of Expertise. Coordinate release plans with key stakeholders and other teams when dependencies exist, while incorporating the team’s estimates. Conduct non-functional controls on the IT product or service delivered by the team, ensuring IT solutions are secure and compliant Your Challenge In 2024, we expanded the Agile Way of Working (WoW) to include the business side by appointing Business Owners (BOs), who gather all functional needs and demands for their respective business domains. Each IT team now has a dedicated Product Owner and Scrum Master. You will join the Accounting & Control IT delivery team, which is responsible for managing the IT landscape that supports the Finance domain. The main challenge is implementing reporting and mapping requirements for ABN AMRO and facilitating the upcoming integration into the ABN AMRO technical landscape. At the same time, you will help ensure the smooth operation and continuous improvement of business-as-usual (BAU) processes, which are pivotal to NIBC’s financial reporting. Your Team You will step into the role of Product Owner for the IT Accounting & Control delivery team at NIBC. This dynamic team is at the heart of managing the IT landscape for our Finance business domain, where we provide essential IT support for NIBC’s general ledger and reporting capabilities. As PO, you will become part of the broader IT Finance & Risk department, which includes the IT Accounting & Control team, the IT Regulatory Reporting team, and the IT Risk, Legal & Compliance team. An IT Service Manager also works in the department. You will report to the Head of IT Finance, Risk & Retail; team members report to the IT Manager Finance & Risk. NIBC as an IT Employer NIBC is on an exciting transformation journey, evolving from a traditional financial services provider into a digital banking company. We are committed to a forward-thinking, can-do attitude, known as our “THINK YES” mentality. Our IT team is a catalyst for digital innovation, driving meaningful changes in our client relationships and business processes. We are closely connected, with few management layers and short lines of communication. If you have a good idea today, you may be executing it tomorrow. What’s in It for You? NIBC is an ambitious environment where we work together to create a fantastic workplace in which you feel safe and challenged to become the best version of yourself. To increase our professionalism, we focus on giving each other continuous feedback. In addition, you will receive a competitive salary, plus: Several ways to support your personal and professional development, including: A personal development budget to spend at your own discretion A professional budget provided by your manager to support your development at work Working in a hybrid way to maintain a healthy work-life balance while still being connected and collaborating physically with each other. This is one of the drivers of our entrepreneurial and inventive culture. NIBC's guideline is to spend at least half of the working time at the office. Travel expenses covered, or a first-class NS Business Card 32 holidays (which do not have to be registered) Excellent pension scheme (26% NIBC contribution) A voucher to improve your home office The opportunity to take ownership and show initiative in your role. We are always open to new ideas and encourage you to use your voice. Our Grow to Make a Difference program enables you to take charge of your own development, with broad growth opportunities within IT. Two staff associations: YoungNIBC and MyLeisure A vitality program and annual company-wide sports and leisure days Monthly internet allowance Laptop and a company phone Excellent facilities at the office, including a coffee corner, restaurant, and bar. Last but not least, a fun workplace where diversity and inclusion are valued. What Do You Bring? Our ideal candidate is a proactive and collaborative Product Owner with: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, or comparable relevant work experience 5+ years of relevant working experience in a leading role within an Agile IT banking environment. Experience with, and knowledge of, finance functions, products, and systems in a banking environment Experience with, and knowledge of, IT, specifically application management and ETL processes Knowledge of IT-related banking regulations and relevant IT standards and best practices A high level of initiative, ownership, and self-motivation, with the ability to work in a team environment. Great communication skills; fluent written and verbal English. Proficiency in Dutch is an advantage. Knowledge of and experience with Agile and Scrum are required Preferably: Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO) / Certified Scrum Product Owner. Preferably: Professional Scrum Product Owner – Advanced (PSPO-A). Understanding of the SAFe model. Still Intrigued? If you're ready to make an impact, click the apply button now. You can upload multiple documents by clicking the upload button again after each upload. Please note that an assessment is part of our application process. For more information about our recruitment procedure or to learn more about NIBC as an employer, feel free to contact our HR team at AskHR@nibc.com. Acquisition by recruitment agencies is not appreciated.

description: Your career at Deutsche Börse Group Your area of work: As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for the functional architecture, coherence, and scalability of one of FundsDLT’s core product areas. FundsDLT is a next-generation market infrastructure for fund distribution, leveraging Distributed Ledger Technology to modernise Transfer Agency, Digital Dealing, and related fund distribution services. In this role, you will ensure that complex client, business, operational, regulatory, and integration needs are translated into scalable product capabilities aligned with the long-term product vision. You will work closely with Product & Engineering, Client Solutions, Product Owners / Head of squads, Technical Architects, Engineering, Client Solutions, and Project Management to ensure the product evolves in a structured, reusable, configurable, and sustainable way. Your responsibilities: Define, maintain, and evolve the target functional model of the product. Build and maintain the product capability map. Identify key business concepts, workflows, rules, dependencies, and areas of variability. Ensure product evolutions remain coherent across functional domains, squads, and delivery streams. Translate client, business, operational, regulatory, integration, and digital asset infrastructure needs into reusable product capabilities. Ensure blockchain, shared ledger, tokenisation, and digital asset infrastructure concepts are reflected in a clear and scalable product model. Determine whether requests should become standard product behaviour, configurable options, reusable integration patterns, temporary exceptions, or should be deferred or reframed. Challenge bespoke client requests when they create unnecessary product complexity or non-scalable customisation. Identify cross-domain impacts and dependencies early. Facilitate alignment between Product Owners / Heads of Squads when several functional domains are impacted. Support Product Owners by providing a clear product architecture framework for domain-level decisions. Contribute to roadmap structuring, sequencing, and change impact analysis from a product architecture perspective. Define principles for standardisation, configuration, customisation, onboarding, and integration patterns. Work with Technical Architects to align functional architecture with technical feasibility, platform constraints and blockchain/DLT design implications. Maintain key product architecture documentation, including capability maps, core workflows, functional rules, configuration principles, integration patterns, and major product decisions, ensuring it remains clear, up to date Your profile: University degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience). 7+ years of experience in Product Architecture, Functional Architecture, Senior Product Ownership, Product Management, Business Architecture, or Solution Architecture with a strong product orientation (ideally within a B2B SaaS or Fintech environment). Strong awareness of blockchain, tokenisation, DLT, shared ledger concepts, APIs, integrations, cloud/SaaS platforms, data flows, interoperability, and release constraints; fluent English required. Strong ability to model complex workflows, business rules, product capabilities, and functional dependencies. Experience with complex B2B SaaS platform in at least one of these areas : fintech, market infrastructure, post-trade, asset servicing, fund distribution, or digital assets / tokenisation Strong understanding of standardisation, configuration, scalability, and multi-client product design. Ability to distinguish between client-specific requests and reusable product capabilities. Experience working with multiple squads, functional domains, and cross-functional delivery teams. Strong analytical, structuring, documentation, and communication skills. Ability to challenge constructively and influence without direct hierarchical authority. Pragmatic, delivery-aware mindset. Strong financial services domain understanding; TA / Digital Dealing exposure is a strong plus, but deep SME expertise is not mandatory if the person can quickly build domain fluency.
